## Summary

<!-- What does this pull request add or change? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New mod listing (`mods/<slug>/`)
- [ ] Update to an existing mod or release
- [ ] Developer profile (`developers/<id>.json`)
- [ ] Website or tooling change

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run build` and committed the regenerated `data/` folder.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] `mod.json` has an English `summary`, and `README.md` exists.
- [ ] The mod has a public, open-source source location (`source`, HTTPS).
- [ ] Downloads only list files I actually published, using HTTPS links. Planned or in-development mods have no downloads.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal data or unverified payment links are included.
- [ ] Translations (`README.ru.md`, `README.fr.md`, etc.) are optional and not required for approval.

I understand that a maintainer must approve this pull request before it is merged and published.
